dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a continuous tangential transition between the leading and trailing edges.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.4 times the vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant water spray and droplet patterns obscuring the pixel data of the anterior-lateral body surface.
